region.text: Carchemish and its district on the west bank of the Euphrates (coordinates 36 49 46 N, 38 00 59 E on the page)

events.note: 848 BC: Sangara's reign ends and with it the only dated tribute to Assyria. Carchemish page: 'Sangara (870-848 BC), the last member of the dynasty, paid tribute to Kings Ashurnasirpal II and Shalmaneser III of Assyria'; 'Following this period, Karkamish does not appear in Assyrian sources until the mid-8th century BC. The only exception was a brief mention by Samsi-Adad V (824-811 BC)'; Astiruwa (ca 848-790 BC) founds the next dynasty. The dossier's vassal_start of 870 ran on to 717 as a bridge; no page gives tribute in between.

region.text: Sam'al round Zincirli Hoyuk in Gaziantep Province, 'near the Nur Mountains' in the Anti-Taurus (infobox coordinates 37 06 13 N, 36 40 43 E); a 40 km circle is the researcher's reading of a 'middle power' whose territories round Carchemish, Quwe and Adana the page does not delimit

events.note: 824 BC: Shalmaneser III dies and Sam'al is independent. Sam'al page: 'Assyrians won over Denyen and Sam'al in 825 BC' and 'Sam'al became independent after the death of Shalmaneser III'; Shalmaneser III page: reign '859-824 BC', he died in his 35th regnal year (824/823 BC) and was succeeded by Shamshi-Adad V. The dossier's 825 vassal_start was bridged to the 717 occupation although its own page ends the tie at his death; the page does not mention Tiglath-Pileser III or any renewed tribute.

union.text: the Delta around Bubastis and Tanis
the Nile valley of Middle and Upper Egypt up to Aswan

correction.text: the Delta around Bubastis and Tanis plus the Nile valley of Middle and Upper Egypt and the Fayyum, the land the ledger gives the dynasty from 943 (the same shape as m1000-m0901 keyframe_overrides/1 for -943..-901); not Cliopatria's whole outline

keyframe_overrides.why: Seam at -900 (reported by m1000-m0901): that window's override of twenty-second-dynasty-of-egypt_-943 ends at -901, and this keyframe, Cliopatria's whole Egypt outline (340,593 km2), snapped the state back to it at -900 (keyframe_snaps: state 437 cells, shape 1148, added 759 = New Valley 525, Red Sea 180, Matruh 48, removed 48) and, with no 'to', ran on to -801 and was unioned with the Lower Egypt keyframe at -837. The dossier's own note holds it for -900..-838 only, so 'to' is -838. Pages: 22nd Dynasty, 'its rulers almost certainly governed from Tanis, which was their capital', 'first ruled over Bubastis'; it is silent on the oases and the Western Desert (it names 'the Western Desert Oases' only for the Twenty-third Dynasty: 'All of its kings reigned in Middle and Upper Egypt including the Western Desert Oases'). Shoshenq I page: his son Iuput was 'High Priest of Amun at Thebes' and 'Governor of Upper Egypt and Commander of the Army', 'to consolidate his authority over the Thebaid', and Nimlot B was 'Leader of the Army' at Herakleopolis in Middle Egypt. Third Intermediate Period page: 'The country was firmly reunited by the Twenty-second Dynasty founded by Shoshenq I in 945 BC (or 943 BC)'. So the Delta, the Nile valley and the Fayyum, as in the -943 override and the ledger's gain of Middle and Upper Egypt (event 1, -943); no desert, Red Sea or Matruh cells. From -837 the dossier's keyframe twenty-second-dynasty-of-egypt_-837 (Lower Egypt) applies alone.
